verdict.rationale: Daytona positions itself as secure infrastructure for running AI-generated code. It documents isolated sandboxes, each with its own kernel, filesystem, network stack and allocated resources, plus dedicated VM sandbox options. Per-sandbox firewalls restrict outbound traffic specifically to stop untrusted code from exfiltrating data, and SDK and code-execution APIs let you run such code programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the isolation holds, and documented detail on the isolation mechanism and escape protections for container sandboxes.
